purpose: Provides supported language, direction, locale, color-scheme, and optional router navigation context to a Veli subtree.

notes: Place VeliProvider at the application or Veli subtree boundary.

useWhen: Veli components need coordinated English or Dhivehi language and direction.
A subtree needs Veli light, dark, or system color-scheme context.
Client-side href navigation on Link, Tabs, Menu, or Breadcrumbs needs a router navigate function.

avoidWhen.situation: A framework theme runtime already owns document-level theme state and must not be overridden.
avoidWhen.guidance: Pass an explicit light or dark colorScheme from that runtime, or keep theme ownership outside VeliProvider.

supportedInteractions: Synchronize .dark, data-theme, and color-scheme on document.documentElement.
Inject an optional blocking theme script via @tradenetcorp/veli-ui/theme-script.
Read active language and color-scheme context through exported hooks.
approvedPatterns: Wrap the application or Veli component subtree once.
Select language rather than passing locale and direction independently.
Pass navigate and useHref when composing router-aware href components.
Use getVeliThemeScript from @tradenetcorp/veli-ui/theme-script when injecting the theme script outside VeliProvider.
limitations: Only English and Dhivehi language mappings are supported.
Only system, light, and dark color schemes are supported.
Router integration requires the consumer to supply navigate and optional useHref.
accessibility: The wrapper sets lang and dir for its subtree.
React Aria receives the mapped locale.
Keep document language and direction coherent when the provider does not wrap the full page.
rtl: Dhivehi maps to dv-MV and rtl.
Direction-aware components should consume provider context or inherited direction.
